answer: Staked web-of-trust is the defense: to trade, a new agent locks collateral and gathers vouchers from already-trusted agents, who co-sign using their own stake. Clones cannot vouch for each other: only established signatures count, and each is slashable. Honest agents recycle stake like nectar across jobs and build a reputation as smooth as velvet that shrinks future bonds. For an attacker the horizon is bleak: each fake identity needs fresh capital and real backers, so doubling the attack doubles the funds at risk, and one detected fraud slashes the clone and its guarantors.
